predictions.rationale: Core logic that listens for the "OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmed" event, triggers the payment workflow, and publishes either success or failure events.
Represents the event published when payment processing succeeds; directly supports the feature’s success path.
Represents the event published when payment processing fails; directly supports the feature’s failure path.
Data contract for the incoming stock-confirmed event that triggers payment processing.
Consumes the success event to update order status; indirectly tied to publishing of success/failure.
Consumes the failure event to update order status; indirectly tied to publishing of success/failure.
Event definition used by Ordering service to react to payment success; supports the overall payment-result workflow.
Event definition used by Ordering service to react to payment failure; supports the overall payment-result workflow.
Registers event bus and wiring required for the payment handler to receive stock-confirmed events and publish result events.
Manages integration event publishing in Ordering service, helping propagate payment success or failure downstream.
